summary.title: {{day}} at a glance
summary.estimates: Nutrition values are estimates. They don't include salt added at the table or drinks.

items.water: Keep a bottle of water nearby. Thirst is often mistaken for hunger.
items.plate: Fill half your plate with vegetables, a quarter with protein and a quarter with starch.
items.cubes: Try one seasoning cube instead of two. Crayfish, onions and pepper add plenty of flavour.
items.batch: Cook beans or moi moi in a big batch and keep portions in the fridge for up to 3 days.
items.swallow: Keep swallows to about the size of your fist and add an extra spoon of vegetable soup.
items.fruit: Fresh fruit is better than juice: you get the fibre and less sugar.
items.walk: A 10-minute walk after meals helps keep blood sugar steady.
